statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.omega_eq_cardDistinctFactors
statements_added.informal: omega n = ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors n, by rfl
statements_added.note: not the same spelling on the two sides: this file uses n.primeFactors.card, Mathlib uses n.primeFactorsList.dedup.length; Nat.primeFactors is primeFactorsList.toFinset so the two unfold to the same term

statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.exceptional_eq_filter_cardDistinctFactors
statements_added.informal: the exceptional set of hardy_ramanujan, written entirely in Mathlib vocabulary

statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.hardy_ramanujan_cardDistinctFactors
statements_added.informal: Hardy-Ramanujan density form with omega, loglog, exceptional and HardyRamanujanTheorem all unfolded away; every name in the statement is Mathlib's

statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.exceptionalPointwise
statements_added.informal: {n in (0,N] : eps * log log n < |omega n - log log n|}

statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.HardyRamanujanPointwise
statements_added.informal: for all eps > 0, card(exceptionalPointwise N eps)/N tends to 0

statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.loglog_band
statements_added.informal: for n <= N with N < n*n and 2 <= N: loglog N - log 2 < loglog n <= loglog N

statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.exceptionalPointwise_subset
statements_added.informal: once (eps+1) log 2 <= (eps/2) loglog N, exceptionalPointwise N eps is contained in {n : n*n <= N} union exceptional N (eps/2)

statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.card_low_range_le
statements_added.informal: card {n in (0,N] : n*n <= N} <= Nat.sqrt N

statements_added.name: ZetaLean.HardyRamanujan.hardy_ramanujan_pointwise
statements_added.informal: for every eps > 0 the density of n <= N with |omega n - log log n| > eps log log n tends to 0

method_notes.split_parameter: delta fixed at 1/2 (the square root), not carried as a parameter
method_notes.slack_cost: log 2, uniform in N, from N < n*n giving log N < 2 log n
method_notes.new_arithmetic_input: none; the variance bound (constant 275) and the Mertens band (16) are consumed unchanged
method_notes.consequence: the pointwise form inherits any future sharpening of the density form without change to this proof
